COMPONENT_REUSE.semantic_definition: Every required component has exactly one declaration and that declaration is in the frozen project-native source_of_truth file.
COMPONENT_REUSE.deterministic_computation: Count the frozen declaration patterns for each required component across source files; true only when total count is one and source_of_truth count is one for every component.

DUPLICATE_COMPONENT_COUNT.semantic_definition: Number of declarations beyond the first for required components across the candidate source tree.
DUPLICATE_COMPONENT_COUNT.deterministic_computation: Sum max(total declarations for component minus one, zero) for every required component.

TOKEN_VIOLATIONS.semantic_definition: Count of declarations using a token-governed CSS property without a known frozen project token variable or a frozen structural literal.
TOKEN_VIOLATIONS.deterministic_computation: Parse CSS declarations; for the frozen governed-property set, count declarations containing an unknown or no token variable unless the complete value is in the structural-literal allowlist.

ARBITRARY_STYLE_DRIFT.semantic_definition: Count of non-token CSS declarations containing a raw color or dimensional/time literal that is not represented by a token variable.
ARBITRARY_STYLE_DRIFT.deterministic_computation: Parse CSS declarations and count each declaration matching the frozen raw-style literal expression when it has no token variable.

STATE_COVERAGE.semantic_definition: Fraction of required state identifiers represented in candidate source text.
STATE_COVERAGE.deterministic_computation: Count required state identifiers with a word-boundary occurrence in source files and divide by required-state count.
STATE_COVERAGE.aggregation: present required states / total required states

ASSET_PROVENANCE.semantic_definition: Every approved asset exists with the frozen digest and every approved asset is referenced by its exact frozen path.
ASSET_PROVENANCE.deterministic_computation: Compare candidate file digests with frozen approved digests and compare normalized source references with approved paths.

ASSET_SUBSTITUTION.semantic_definition: An asset reference is external or not in the approved manifest, or an approved asset digest differs.
ASSET_SUBSTITUTION.deterministic_computation: Return true when any normalized referenced asset is not approved or any approved asset content digest differs.
ASSET_SUBSTITUTION.aggregation: any substitution makes the metric true

RESPONSIVE_CONTAINMENT.semantic_definition: Candidate CSS represents the frozen tablet and desktop breakpoints and includes the three frozen containment declarations.
RESPONSIVE_CONTAINMENT.deterministic_computation: Require media queries containing the frozen tablet and desktop values plus overflow-x auto/hidden, min-width 0, and max-width 100% declarations.
RESPONSIVE_CONTAINMENT.aggregation: all breakpoint and containment predicates must pass

ACCESSIBILITY_INVARIANTS.semantic_definition: All thirteen frozen accessibility invariants have deterministic source evidence.
ACCESSIBILITY_INVARIANTS.deterministic_computation: Apply the frozen regular-expression evidence predicate for each invariant; true only when all invariant predicates pass.

UNRESOLVED_MAPPINGS.semantic_definition: Count frozen unresolved-mapping markers in candidate source files.
UNRESOLVED_MAPPINGS.deterministic_computation: Count case-insensitive occurrences of UNRESOLVED_MAPPING, TODO_MAPPING, MAPPING_REQUIRED, or UNKNOWN_MAPPING.

REVISION_MISMATCH.semantic_definition: A frozen fixture contract or dependency manifest differs from the canonical fixture.
REVISION_MISMATCH.deterministic_computation: Compare normalized SHA-256 digests for every frozen contract file.
REVISION_MISMATCH.aggregation: any digest difference makes the metric true

VISUAL_BASELINE_REPLACEMENT.semantic_definition: The approved visual/reference identity is replaced or an approved asset is substituted.
VISUAL_BASELINE_REPLACEMENT.deterministic_computation: Return true for asset substitution, a frozen baseline replacement marker, or a reference-identity mismatch.
VISUAL_BASELINE_REPLACEMENT.aggregation: any replacement predicate makes the metric true

DETERMINISTIC_ACCEPTANCE.semantic_definition: The independently produced validator record proves every required deterministic fixture and candidate gate passed with zero calls, zero network access, and zero external mutation.
DETERMINISTIC_ACCEPTANCE.deterministic_computation: Validate the validator-result schema, compare all frozen identity and candidate digests, require PASS for every check, and require all four zero-side-effect counters.
DETERMINISTIC_ACCEPTANCE.aggregation: all validator checks and identity predicates must pass
